False. The Environmental Assessment Act 2000 was enacted by Bhutan’s National Assembly, not published by the Office of the Attorney General.

False. Bhutan’s Biodiversity Act 2003 was never published in India’s Gazette; it appeared in Bhutan’s own official gazette.
False. The Environmental Assessment Act of Bhutan, 2000 is a Bhutanese statute, not a Sri Lankan government publication.
False. Bhutan’s official legal publications are issued by its own authorities, not Sri Lanka’s Department of Government Printing.
